stories.title: 'They're all brothers and sisters' | Local veterans rally to cover Fort Sam Houston National Cemetery graves with holiday wreaths
stories.summary: Last Christmas, more than 107,000 graves were left without a wreath.

stories.title: 'We'll see him again': Family remembers truck driver killed in fiery crash along I-35
stories.summary: Family says witnesses told police that they saw 61-year-old Joe Barrientes slumped over before the crash.

stories.title: Expect temporary lane closures on north side for VIA Green Line work
stories.summary: Overhead utility work will take place from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Monday, Nov. 23. Weather permitting, VIA said crews should be clear by midday.

stories.title: Hondo police: Man dies after altercation tied to ongoing dispute, 2 suspects in custody
stories.summary: Investigators said witnesses told them the incident started as a physical fight that stemmed from an ongoing dispute between multiple people.

stories.title: Missing 21-year-old woman with cerebral palsy found, Comal County sheriff says
stories.summary: She was last seen wearing a black long-sleeve pajama top and black pajama pants.

stories.title: Dominant Cowboys offense shines as they lead Titans 27-9 at halftime
stories.summary: Dallas dominates early with touchdowns on their first four drives, showcasing Dak Prescott's offense against a struggling Titans defense

stories.title: SAPD: 2 suspects wanted after man robbed at gunpoint in east-side store, reward offered for information
stories.summary: Investigators said the suspects may have been been driving a newer-model black Nissan Kicks.

stories.title: 12-year-old boy shot outside northeast Houston apartment complex, police say
stories.summary: "He looked at his leg, saw an injury, blood coming out, ran back to his apartment, told his mom about it, and HFD was called out," said HPD Lt. Ali.

stories.title: Arrest made in shooting that killed woman on her birthday in Dallas, police say
stories.summary: A woman was fatally shot on the night of Nov. 15 after being involved in a crash in southeast Dallas.

stories.title: Father faces DWI charge after 8-year-old critically hurt from falling out of moving car in west Houston, police say
stories.summary: Police said the child was rushed to an area hospital in "very critical condition."

stories.summary: Gomez's courtside visit also happened to coincide with a historic night for Spurs star Victor Wembanyama.
